newsitem.title: CANADA: Cinar to buy facility from Caspian.
newsitem.headline: Cinar to buy facility from Caspian.

text.p: CINAR Films Inc said on Thursday it agreed to buy the FilmFair Library and animation production facilities and other animated series from Caspian Group Plc for 10.5 million pounds sterling in cash and stock.

CINAR said the library was based mainly on children's literary properties, comprising more than 200 half hours of animation and featured such titles as "Paddington Bear", "The Herbs" and "Simon in the Land of Chalk Drawings", Roald Dahl's "Dirty Beasts and Revolting Rhymes" and Elisabeth Beresford's "The Wombles".
The purchase price will be paid by 6.75 million pounds sterling in cash and 272,500 class B subordinate voting shares.
CINAR said the purchase would increase its total library to about 950 half hours by the end of the year.

It obtained all rights to the titles previously held by Caspian, including television, video, music publishing, licensing and merchandising rights as well as the right to produce new episodes of many series.
